note: Listening scenes for the Oberstufe (A2): first drafts for the parents to check. right = the index of the right answer.

lines: The train to Bern leaves from platform four at ten past eight.
scenes.question: Von welchem Gleis fährt der Zug?

lines: A: A return ticket to Zurich, please.
B: That's thirty-two francs.
A: Here you are.
scenes.question: Wie viel kostet das Billett?

lines: We are sorry. The train to Lucerne is about fifteen minutes late.
scenes.question: Wie viel Verspätung hat der Zug?

lines: A: Where is your suitcase?
B: Oh no! I left it on the bus.
scenes.question: Wo ist der Koffer?

lines: Last summer we went to Italy by car. It took us seven hours.
scenes.question: Wie reiste die Familie nach Italien?

lines: A: Excuse me, how do I get to the airport?
B: Take bus number five. It stops right in front of the station.
scenes.question: Welchen Bus soll man nehmen?

lines: For tomorrow, please read page forty-five and answer the questions.
scenes.question: Welche Seite sollen sie lesen?

lines: A: When is the English test?
B: On Thursday, after the break.
scenes.question: Wann ist der Englischtest?

lines: My favourite subject is geography, because I love maps.
scenes.question: Was ist das Lieblingsfach der Person?

lines: A: Can I borrow your ruler?
B: Sorry, I only have a pencil and a rubber.
scenes.question: Was möchte A ausleihen?

lines: Next Monday our class is going to the Transport Museum in Lucerne.
scenes.question: Wohin geht die Klasse?

lines: A: Who is your new maths teacher?
B: Mrs Keller. She's strict, but very fair.
scenes.question: Wie ist die neue Mathelehrerin?

lines: My sister is two years older than me. She's sixteen.
scenes.question: Wie alt ist die Schwester?

lines: A: Where does your grandmother live?
B: In a small village near Thun.
scenes.question: Wo wohnt die Grossmutter?

lines: It's my dad's birthday on Saturday. We're going to make a cake for him.
scenes.question: Was macht die Familie für den Vater?

lines: A: Is that your brother in the photo?
B: No, that's my cousin Leo. He lives in Canada.
scenes.question: Wer ist auf dem Foto?

lines: We have two cats and a dog. The dog is called Max.
scenes.question: Wie heisst der Hund?

lines: A: Mum, what's for dinner?
B: Pasta with tomato sauce. Can you set the table, please?
scenes.question: Was soll das Kind tun?

lines: I play football three times a week, on Monday, Wednesday and Friday.
scenes.question: Wie oft spielt die Person Fussball?

lines: A: Do you want to go to the cinema tonight?
B: Sorry, I can't. I have to study for a test.
scenes.question: Warum kann B nicht mitkommen?

lines: My brother has been playing the guitar for four years.
scenes.question: Seit wann spielt der Bruder Gitarre?

lines: A: Shall we meet at the swimming pool?
B: Good idea. Let's meet at two o'clock at the entrance.
scenes.question: Um wie viel Uhr treffen sie sich?

lines: On rainy days I like to play board games with my friends.
scenes.question: Was macht die Person an Regentagen?

lines: A: Did you go skiing at the weekend?
B: No, there wasn't enough snow, so we went hiking instead.
scenes.question: Was haben sie am Wochenende gemacht?

lines: A: What would you like?
B: A cheese sandwich and an apple juice, please.
scenes.question: Was trinkt B?

lines: For breakfast I usually have bread with butter and honey.
scenes.question: Was isst die Person zum Frühstück?

lines: A: Would you like some cake?
B: No, thank you. I can't eat nuts.
scenes.question: Warum isst B keinen Kuchen?

lines: In winter we often eat cheese fondue with my grandparents.
scenes.question: Mit wem isst die Familie Fondue?

lines: A: How much is a pizza margherita?
B: Eighteen francs fifty.
scenes.question: Wie viel kostet die Pizza?

lines: A: Can you cook?
B: A little. My best dish is spaghetti bolognese.
scenes.question: Was kocht B am besten?

lines: My mother is a nurse. She works at the hospital, often at night.
scenes.question: Wo arbeitet die Mutter?

lines: A: What do you want to be in the future?
B: I'd like to be a carpenter. I love working with wood.
scenes.question: Was möchte B werden?

lines: The baker gets up at three o'clock in the morning to make fresh bread.
scenes.question: Um wie viel Uhr steht der Bäcker auf?

lines: My cousin is doing an apprenticeship as a mechanic. It takes four years.
scenes.question: Wie lange dauert die Lehre?

lines: A: Why do you want this job?
B: Because I like helping people and I'm good with children.
scenes.question: Womit ist B gut?

lines: My father works in an office in Bern. He goes there by train every day.
scenes.question: Wie fährt der Vater zur Arbeit?

lines: A: What's the matter?
B: I've got a terrible headache and I feel tired.
scenes.question: Was tut B weh?

lines: I fell off my bike and broke my arm. Now I can't write.
scenes.question: Was hat sich die Person gebrochen?

lines: Take one tablet three times a day, after meals.
scenes.question: Wie oft soll man eine Tablette nehmen?

lines: A: You don't look well.
B: I think I've got a cold. My throat hurts.
scenes.question: Was tut B weh?

lines: Teenagers need about nine hours of sleep every night.
scenes.question: Wie viele Stunden Schlaf brauchen Jugendliche?

lines: A: I have an appointment with the dentist at half past four.
B: Good luck!
scenes.question: Wann ist der Termin beim Zahnarzt?

lines: We live in a flat on the third floor. There's no lift, so we always take the stairs.
scenes.question: In welchem Stock wohnt die Familie?

lines: A: What's your bedroom like?
B: It's small, but I have a big window with a view of the lake.
scenes.question: Was sieht man aus dem Fenster?

lines: Every Saturday I have to tidy my room and take out the rubbish.
scenes.question: Was muss die Person jeden Samstag tun?

lines: A: Have you seen my keys?
B: Yes, they're on the kitchen table, next to the newspaper.
scenes.question: Wo sind die Schlüssel?

lines: Our house has a small garden where my mum grows tomatoes.
scenes.question: Was pflanzt die Mutter im Garten?

lines: A: We're moving to a new house next month.
B: Really? Will you change schools?
A: No, it's in the same town.
scenes.question: Muss A die Schule wechseln?

lines: A: Excuse me, where is the post office?
B: Go straight on, then turn left. It's next to the bank.
scenes.question: Wo ist die Post?

lines: There's a market in the old town every Tuesday and Saturday morning.
scenes.question: Wann ist Markt?

lines: The library is open from nine in the morning until six in the evening.
scenes.question: Bis wann ist die Bibliothek offen?

lines: A: Where shall we meet?
B: In front of the cinema, next to the big fountain.
scenes.question: Wo treffen sie sich?

lines: The number seven bus goes to the hospital every ten minutes.
scenes.question: Wie oft fährt der Bus?

lines: A: I'm lost. Is this Bahnhofstrasse?
B: No, this is Marktgasse. Bahnhofstrasse is the second street on the right.
scenes.question: Wo ist die Bahnhofstrasse?

lines: Tomorrow it will be sunny in the morning, but it will rain in the afternoon.
scenes.question: Wie wird das Wetter am Nachmittag?

lines: A: How cold is it outside?
B: Minus five degrees. Put on your hat and gloves!
scenes.question: Wie kalt ist es draussen?

lines: We climbed up the mountain for three hours, and at the top we saw an eagle.
scenes.question: Welches Tier sahen sie oben?

lines: A: Did you hear the storm last night?
B: Yes! A tree fell onto our neighbour's car.
scenes.question: Was ist passiert?
answers: Ein Baum fiel auf ein Auto.

lines: In summer the water in the lake is about twenty-two degrees, perfect for swimming.
scenes.question: Wie warm ist das Wasser im Sommer?

lines: A: What's your favourite season?
B: Autumn. I love the colours of the leaves.
scenes.question: Welche Jahreszeit mag B am liebsten?

lines: A: Can I try these shoes in size forty-one?
B: Of course. Here you are.
scenes.question: Welche Schuhgrösse möchte A?

lines: These jeans were eighty francs, but today they're half price.
scenes.question: Wie viel kosten die Jeans heute?

lines: Don't forget: we need milk, eggs and a loaf of bread.
scenes.question: Was steht nicht auf der Einkaufsliste?

lines: A: Do you have this T-shirt in blue?
B: Sorry, only in black or white.
scenes.question: Welche Farben gibt es?

lines: A: That's twelve francs.
B: Here's twenty.
A: Thank you. Here's your change: eight francs.
scenes.question: Wie viel Rückgeld bekommt B?

lines: I'm looking for a present for my mum. She loves books about cooking.
scenes.question: Was für ein Geschenk wird gesucht?

lines: A: Are you nervous about the concert?
B: A little, but I've practised a lot.
scenes.question: Wie fühlt sich B?

lines: I'm so happy! I got a six in my French test.
scenes.question: Warum ist die Person glücklich?

lines: My sister is angry with me because I broke her phone.
scenes.question: Warum ist die Schwester wütend?

lines: A: What's wrong?
B: Nothing. I'm just bored. There's nothing to do.
scenes.question: Wie fühlt sich B?

lines: Tom is sad because his best friend is moving to Geneva.
scenes.question: Wohin zieht der beste Freund?

lines: A: Why don't you want to go in?
B: I'm scared of spiders, and there are lots in that old house.
scenes.question: Wovor hat B Angst?
